_note: Layout and guide fixes after the fifth (cold) playtest (docs/design/playtest-5-cold.md). Plain words, reading age 11, no sentence over 18 words.
replay.note: Starts a new game with the guide switched on.
guide.lookup: Look it up opens the atlas and the rule book. They show every council area and every rule, with sources.
ctl.notebook_title: Counts the council areas you have looked at in this game
promise.none: No promise this turn. No card you hold, or one arriving now, can help a goal before the turn ends.
promise.none_note: Trust does not rise or fall from a promise this turn.
promise.in_hand: Cards in your hand that can help it this turn: {cards}.
promise.landing: Already played and starting to work this turn: {cards}.
promise.decline_note: Make no promise and Trust does not change because of one.
crisis.none: You saved no coins, so you cannot cut the damage. It hits in full.
crisis.budget_cut.one: It also takes 1 coin off next turn's budget, whatever you spend now.
crisis.budget_cut.other: It also takes {n} coins off next turn's budget, whatever you spend now.
crisis.go_on: Carry on: the crisis hits in full
crisis.response_none_saved: You had no coins saved, so nothing could cut it.
result.fund_kept: You kept them back from the crisis.
trust.card_up: {detail} was popular where it was built.
trust.curveball_up: A slow change made life a little easier.
visit.slow: Work starts there now. The card works from {year}.
visit.now: Good choices there make the card work better.
visit.why_trend_bethesda: No card of yours is at work in the valley. It asks you anyway: {trend} bears on it this turn.
visit.why_plain: No card of yours is at work there. The valley asks you to come and choose what it does first.
visit.why_plain_short: It asks you to come this turn.
card.if_example: If you play this, for example in {place}
card.scope_choice: All of Wales: a small change everywhere. One region: a bigger change there, and none elsewhere.
card.scope_region: You choose one region. The card works there, and not elsewhere.
needs.card: Full strength only if you have played {card}, this turn or before.
needs.below: Half as strong while Wales is short of trained workers.
needs.below_cards: Half as strong while Wales is short of trained workers. Play {cards} to train them.
needs.partners: Full strength only with local help: Regions work together there, or a visit that goes well.
needs.unless_scope: Its downside there is avoided if {card} is already working in that region.
needs.unless_force: Its downside is avoided while {card} is working.
budget.cap.one: Trust lets you play 1 card this turn.
budget.cap.other: Trust lets you play up to {n} cards this turn.
budget.cap_full: No more cards this turn: Trust allows {n}.
guide.scores: Life now scores Wales today, out of 100. The small 2050 marker on each bar shows what will be left.
